scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist/downloads/nexora-technologies.apk', {force:true})" && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease && cd .. && npm run copy:apk
scripts.copy:apk: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const src = 'android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk'; const publicTarget = 'public/downloads/nexora-technologies.apk'; const distTarget = 'dist/downloads/nexora-technologies.apk'; if (!fs.existsSync(src)) throw new Error('Signed release APK not found. Run npm run build:apk first.'); fs.mkdirSync('public/downloads', {recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync(src, publicTarget); if (fs.existsSync('dist')) { fs.mkdirSync('dist/downloads', {recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync(src, distTarget); } console.log('Signed release APK copied to public and dist downloads.');"
